describes: Current annotation records mirror, flat list loads, cursor replay, current document facts and lifetime.

cases.name: hydrates-every-page-at-open
cases.covers: A single flat annotations.list loads current DTOs and canonical page refs; reads and whenSynced see the mirror.

cases.name: no-read-grant-means-forbidden
cases.covers: Without doc.annotate.read the mirror refuses hydration without an engine read; refresh rechecks the gate.

cases.name: a-failed-hydration-degrades-to-live
cases.covers: Failed bulk load reports error while queued/live facts still fold; a later full refresh returns ready.

cases.name: the-hydration-window-replays-by-cursor
cases.covers: The flat snapshot cursor drops already included facts; newer and cursorless confirmed facts replay after load.

cases.name: a-local-engine-replays-everything
cases.covers: A snapshot without an audit cursor replays all queued facts in arrival order.

cases.name: mixed-type-cursors-compare-as-javascript
cases.covers: Explicit malformed upstream cursor values retain the current JS comparison behavior; ordinary events remain complete.

cases.name: a-null-cursor-reads-as-zero
cases.covers: A null snapshot cursor means no watermark in the current mirror, so all numeric event cursors replay.

cases.name: string-cursors-compare-as-strings
cases.covers: Explicit malformed string watermark and event cursors exercise the actual current mirror comparison, not an old adapter.

cases.name: live-remote-events
cases.covers: Current created/updated/reordered/deleted facts fold from all origins; changed appearance advances the picture epoch.

cases.name: confirmed-origin-delivery
cases.covers: The actual engine stream delivers complete local/remote origins unchanged to public fact listeners.

cases.name: records-without-a-ref
cases.covers: Explicit malformed protocol negative: a required Annotation.ref is absent. The current mirror reports a failed fold and reloads; a malformed full load preserves the last confirmed data and status error.

cases.name: stable-base-index-records
cases.covers: Current reads can name a base annotation by immutable baseIndex; get/update identity no longer depends on an index revision or absent ref.

cases.name: rehydrate-chains-after-the-flight
cases.covers: A refresh during an in-flight reload schedules one further load, and current stream.desynced starts the reload.

cases.name: page-membership-events
cases.covers: Current complete layout facts drop retired pages and reload newly inserted pages through annotations.list({pages}).

cases.name: cross-plane-events
cases.covers: Current redaction.applied reloads only applied pages using the flat list; unchanged pages keep records and their picture versions.

cases.name: restored-page-reloads
cases.covers: The current annotations.restored event requests a page load; a failed reload keeps the previous view and status error.

cases.name: closing-unsubscribes
cases.covers: Closing releases the annotation mirror event subscription and document-scoped state.
cases.reason: Subscription lifetime is visible in engineState.

cases.name: rotated-page-layout
cases.covers: Annotations already live in page space on rotated/offset pages; no removed PDF/content bridge is called.
